title: Pure Watt
summary: Pure Watt build with generic Thunder Extra Deck support and staples. Watt monsters are low-Level LIGHT Thunders that attack directly, triggering searches, hand disruption, and effect locks on every direct hit before climbing into Watt Synchros during the Battle Phase.

summary.title: Starters
points: Wattcobra attacks directly and searches any Watt monster from the Deck when it inflicts battle damage by a direct attack.
Wattkingdom Special Summons a Watt monster with a different name from the Deck while you control a Watt, locking you to Thunder summons for the turn.

Wattrain adds up to as many Watt cards with different names from your Deck as the number of Thunder monsters you control, then banishes itself from the GY on a later turn to Special Summon as many Watt monsters with different names as possible from your hand.

summary.title: Opening: Wattcobra + Wattkingdom
steps: Normal Summon Wattcobra and activate Wattkingdom to Special Summon Wattgiraffe from the Deck.
Attack directly with Wattgiraffe first so the opponent cannot activate cards or effects for the rest of the turn, then attack directly with Wattcobra to search Wattuna.
At the end of the Damage Step, Special Summon Wattuna from the hand and Tribute it alongside a Level 4 Watt to Special Summon Level 6 Wattchimera or Level 8 Wattkyuki as a Synchro Summon.

summary.title: Direct-Attack Synchro Climb
summary.text: Wattuna Special Summons itself from the hand at the end of the Damage Step when your monster inflicts battle damage, and when it inflicts direct battle damage it Tributes itself and non-Tuners from your hand or field to treat the Special Summon of a Watt Synchro as a Synchro Summon. Level 8 Wattkyuki also attacks directly and after damage calculation shuffles a Watt Tuner from your field and a non-Tuner Thunder from your GY into the Deck to Special Summon another Watt Synchro from the Extra Deck.

summary.title: Control & Bosses
points: Wattchimera places a random card from the opponent's hand on top of their Deck when it inflicts direct battle damage, while Watthydra banishes any card from your Deck face-down to add to your hand two Standby Phases later.
Wattkingdom negates the activated effects of monsters the opponent Normal or Special Summons in the same columns as your Watt monsters.

Thunder Dragon Colossus can be Special Summoned in Main Phase 2 after a Thunder monster's effect was activated in the hand (such as Wattuna or Wattkinetic Puppeteer) by Tributing a non-Fusion Thunder monster, locking the opponent out of searching.
Wattcancel discards a Watt monster to negate an opponent's Normal or Special Summon, and Watthopper shields other face-up Watts from attacks and targeting.

summary.title: Spells
points: Wattsychic Fighting Porter Special Summons up to two Level 3 or lower LIGHT monsters from the hand, granting them direct attacks if they share an original Type and Attribute.
Wattkey allows all face-up Watt monsters you control to attack directly for the turn.
